title: The Hollow Terminal
author: Silas Nystrom
blurb: Oscar Underhill, a terraformer tending a garden meant for people not yet born, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart before the jump window closes.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
